notice: This static file is not the DMT Code corpus and it contains no data. The live machine-readable corpus is generated from the database at request time and is served at this same path, https://dmtcode.com/data.json, by a Netlify edge function. If you are reading this text then that function did not run. Treat this as a service outage rather than as data, retry shortly, and do not cache this response as the dataset.
key_policy: Keys are omitted when the value is unknown. An absent key means unknown, not false or zero. This file deliberately omits a symbols key, because it holds no symbols and an empty array here would read as a registry with nothing in it.
removed_2026_07_29: Until 2026-07-29 this file held a symbols array of 52 entries with the ids symbol_001 through symbol_052, a tools array of 14 products with prices and external store links, and a faq array of 15 entries. It carried the date 2025-11-28. None of those 52 symbols corresponded to a record in the registry database, and each one carried a DOI, which presented an invented description as though a published paper had documented it. The faq array asserted an inter-subject consistency rate that this project has never measured, a memory-decay percentage attributed to a 2001 source, and an automatic stroke-counting and pattern-searching feature that no table in this database has ever supported. All of it was removed rather than corrected, because none of it could be sourced. No database record was changed and no submission was affected.
